SELECT
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toMonth(fs.DateKey) BETWEEN 1 AND 6) AS h1_sales_2009,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toMonth(fs.DateKey) BETWEEN 7 AND 12) AS h2_sales_2009,
    h2_sales_2009 - h1_sales_2009 AS comeback_amount,
    if(h1_sales_2009 = 0, NULL, (h2_sales_2009 - h1_sales_2009) / h1_sales_2009) AS comeback_pct
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON fs.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY
    p.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName
HAVING h2_sales_2009 > h1_sales_2009
ORDER BY
    comeback_amount DESC,
    h2_sales_2009 DESC
LIMIT 10
